command:
(
printf 'R111_UNAME='; uname -r
printf 'R111_BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'R111_PAYLOAD_BYTES='; wc -c < /tmp/r107-stage111/fw_payload-stage111.bin
printf 'R111_PAYLOAD_SHA='; sha256sum /tmp/r107-stage111/fw_payload-stage111.bin
printf 'R111_UPDATER_SHA='; sha256sum /usr/bin/platform-sd-update
printf 'R111_PARTITION_SIZE='; cat /sys/class/block/mmcblk0p1/size
printf 'R111_PARTITION_START='; cat /sys/class/block/mmcblk0p1/start
printf 'R111_MOUNTS\n'; cat /proc/mounts
printf 'R111_BOOT_READONLY_END\n'
)
limits: TTY open/configuration can affect host modem state; no explicit DTR/RTS control. Framed task-owned UART command; no proof of live BIT hash, mode, or physical clock.
